verdict.line: You lose if you eat Cannon-stance poke for free before 6 and let him farm from range; you win if you force a stance commitment and land E into Q before he resets.

brief.thesis: Jayce's entire kit is gated by which weapon stance he's in — Hammer Stance gives him the leap and knockback to fight you in melee, Cannon Stance gives him poke and the gate, but he can't have both active at once and each stance's abilities sit on long cooldowns (Thundering Blow is 20/18/16/14/12s). Irelia's full stun combo is online by level 2 with E, so any window where Jayce is stuck in the wrong stance or on cooldown is a window you can walk Bladesurge into and kill him in. That stance-dependency is why Irelia sits at 56.5% over 4,212 games with both lane and solo-kill advantage here.

theirWindow.when: Cannon Stance with Acceleration Gate deployed
theirWindow.what: He's set up to poke safely — Shock Blast (Q) fired through his own Acceleration Gate (E) gets extra range, speed, and damage. Don't walk into minion wave contact until you've confirmed the gate is down or his Q is on cooldown (16/14/12/10/8s).

yourWindow.when: Flawless Duet (E) lands with 4 passive stacks
yourWindow.what: The instant E converges and stuns/Marks him, dash in with Q — the Mark refreshes Bladesurge's cooldown on hit — and auto through your Ionian Fervor attack-speed stacks. This is the all-in; don't throw E for poke damage alone.

start.why: Sustain and raw AD to win the early trades where Jayce is still committing to a stance to fight you.

boots.why: Blunts the auto-attack chip damage from both his Hammer Stance autos and Cannon Stance W (Hyper Charge) burst.

core.why: Percent-health on-hit and the slow punish his kiting in Cannon Stance and shred him in extended duels.
Converts your lane lead into split-push pressure he can't match once you're ahead.
Lets you tank through his burst windows (Shock Blast, Mercury Cannon empowered auto) and keep swinging.

the enemy team adds magic damage threats alongside Jayce
the game goes long and you need to survive dive attempts
you're facing extra CC or magic damage on top of this lane

runes.keystoneWhy: Stacking adaptive damage and the healing conversion reward exactly the extended all-in trades this matchup is built around.

summoners.why: Flash+Ignite is run in 60.4% of games at 56.5% win rate — Ignite closes out the early kill windows your E+Q all-in opens before Jayce can disengage with a stance swap.

playing.title: Track his stance, not his HP
playing.detail: Whichever stance Jayce is NOT in is the weak one — if he just used Thundering Blow (Hammer E, 20-12s CD) to knock you back, he can't gate or poke until he swaps back to Cannon.

playing.title: Punish the knockback, don't fear it
playing.detail: Thundering Blow has a 240 range and a real cooldown. The moment he uses it, close the gap with Q (Bladesurge) before he can reset the distance.

playing.title: All-in only off a landed E
playing.detail: Flawless Duet stuns and Marks on hit — that's your signal to dash in with Q, which refreshes off the Mark, not a poke tool to throw from max range.

playing.title: Charge W into his burst
playing.detail: Defiant Dance takes reduced physical damage while charging — hold it for his Q leap or empowered Mercury Cannon auto rather than using it on cooldown.

playing.title: Respect the gate, not the whole lane
playing.detail: If he's deployed Acceleration Gate in Cannon Stance, his next Shock Blast through it hits harder and farther — back off the wave until that's spent.

playing.title: Close the game before 11
playing.detail: Your lane and solo-kill advantage are both early; don't let the game drag into the 12-18 window where his poke scales back up.

brief.patchCaveat: Build paths, rune pages, and all win-rate/sample numbers are measured from live games on the current patch via OP.GG; the stance-timing and trade-pattern reasoning is my own read of the ability mechanics, not scraped data.
